scope: Fixed receiver-time ranges ending at the connection6 input spans; global rows are not assigned to either attack without a request/connection identifier.
limitations: Range starts are observedEnd-duration arithmetic, not authoritative operation-start timestamps.
Observed timestamps are collection/receive timestamps, and nested spans overlap; durations must not be added.
Unscoped session/flush/save rows cannot be uniquely assigned to connection6.
Only >=50ms emitted stages exist; absence cannot exclude a shorter stage or uninstrumented work.
